title: He Knew What Was in Man
description: This sermon delves into the profound knowledge and omniscience of Jesus Christ, emphasizing the importance of genuine faith rooted in the glory of Christ rather than being swayed by signs and wonders. It highlights how Jesus knows everything about us, loves us, and willingly sacrificed Himself despite knowing the depths of human hearts. The sermon challenges listeners to examine the authenticity of their faith, warning against being mere sign chasers and false prophets, and encourages a deep, personal encounter with the self-authenticating glory of Christ.
